rounds.outcome: not reviewed rule by rule: four proposals were the same regex under different names and one matched the author's tag names instead of caption text. The agent's tools were changed (near-duplicate guard, minimum support, pool_examples tool, clearer prompt) and the agent was rerun.

decisions.reason: Captions with stock-illustration boilerplate were rated 3 (accurate, boilerplate-capped), not bad (precision 0.09 against 'rated 1-2'). Deleting them would remove a whole image type (illustrations, ~6% of the pool) and reduce diversity; re-captioning (arm E) addresses the boilerplate without dropping the images.
It just copies my examples: its words were lifted from specific hand-rated captions ('Technology', 'Etsy', 'PERSON> letter'), and on the pool it also removes good captions.

rounds.tool_fix_after_review: propose() did not enforce the stated precision >= 0.7; contains_boilerplate passed because of that. MIN_PRECISION is now enforced for any future run.
